summary: I retested the two iteration_11 fixes on the backend only, and both pass. (1) All-rejected recovery, via the public URL, in one session with active_place from each route_set and again without it. 'I need fuel' offered Capitol, then each 'not that one' moved on: Sierra, Northgate, Delta. The 4th one returned the chat line 'That's every one I found nearby. Want me to go back to one of them?'. 'yes, go back to the first one' returned route_set to Capitol Truck Plaza, and 'take the Sierra one' returned route_set to Sierra Fuel & Truck Stop. (2) /api/speak pinning: 'Okay, one sec.' returned the same id 600681590d830523dedf15e9adb558bf on every call. After `supervisorctl restart backend` the same id came back in about 0.13s. No new api.elevenlabs.io request was logged, the cache files' modified times did not change and no extra file appeared. GET /api/voice/audio/{id} returned 200 audio/mpeg. A brand-new test line created exactly 1 cache file, and repeating it returned the same id. (3) The requested regression suite gave 79 passed.

minor.issue: Before the restart, a new /api/speak line was generated (new file in .tts_cache) but no httpx 'api.elevenlabs.io' line was logged. Right after the restart the same kind of request was logged. Likely cause: LiteLLM, used for the LLM calls, raises the httpx logger level once it is used. So 'no ElevenLabs line in the log' only proves anything before the first LLM call. I confirmed the result through file modified times and file counts instead.
Cosmetic: going back to Capitol after the all-rejected line repeats the exact first reply ('Alright, got one. Capitol Truck Plaza...'). There is no 'back to' wording.

action_items: Optional: set logging.getLogger('httpx').setLevel(logging.INFO) after LiteLLM is imported, so ElevenLabs calls are always logged.
Optional: use a 'back to X' route reply when the driver picks a place that was already offered.
critical_code_review_comments: agent._find pops sess['rejected'] on ALL_REJECTED. This is correct, and pick_place then resolves from sess['places'], which stays as the last route plus its options because the chat reply has no place.
voice.pinned/get_audio read the stable sha1-based id from disk, so restarts reuse it. pin() drops the uuid copy from _AUDIO_CACHE, so there is no duplicate.
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ sessions only (in memory). I deleted the 2 TEST .tts_cache files I created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: frontend/.env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Places are MOCKED demo data. Pinned TTS lives in /app/backend/.tts_cache/<sha1[:32]>.mp3.
